default.notes: Visa required — apply at a Paraguayan embassy or consulate. Check the Ministry of Foreign Affairs portal first: a number of nationalities can apply for the eVisa online instead.

groups.notes: Visa-free under Mercosur/associate arrangements — nationals can enter with just their national ID card (no passport needed) and stay up to 90 days; an extension (prórroga) can be requested from the Dirección General de Migraciones.
Visa-free for tourism up to 90 days; the Dirección General de Migraciones can grant one extension before the stay expires.

Commonly listed among Paraguay's visa-exempt nationalities for short tourist stays, but the exemption list is amended by decree from time to time — confirm with a Paraguayan consulate or the eVisa portal before booking.

PY.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Paraguayan citizens.

VE.notes: A visa is required and consular arrangements between Paraguay and Venezuela have been disrupted since diplomatic relations were broken off — allow extra time and apply through a Paraguayan consulate in a third country if necessary.

TW.notes: Paraguay is one of the few states with full diplomatic relations with Taiwan, and Taiwanese passport holders enter visa-free for up to 90 days.
